name: asana
description: Reads implemented Asana project-management streams and executes typed, approval-gated reverse-ETL write actions across tasks, projects, sections, tags, stories, goals, portfolios, teams, users, and workspaces. Tracks every official Asana API operation from the pinned OpenAPI source as covered or blocked/planned fixed-target metadata.

risk.read: external Asana API reads use fixed declared streams or blocked/planned fixed-target command metadata; no raw provider query/path passthrough
risk.write: external mutations require named reverse-ETL actions, schemas, previews, explicit approval, and typed destructive confirmation when destructive/admin
risk.approval: all write execution follows plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive actions also require confirm: destructive
